body.asks: Whether an act's gone takes a holon out of every store that holds it, each applying only what it holds, so that letting a holon go from one store alone is another act, not yet designed.

name: Gone means out of the field

body.asks: How the engine finishes an act found in one store's log and missing from another that has moved since, its blocks pinned by their prev; refused as landing refuses where both changed one holon, and otherwise chained on.

name: Finishing an act on a store that moved

body.asks: Which store the engine reads and judges a holon kept in several by, where today the first store that may hold an id is taken as its owner.

name: Which store answers for a holon kept in several

body.asks: How a line says which of an act's blocks are this store's: an own list of their hashes, written whenever the act touched another store, by blocks or by gone alone, own: [] apart from absent; the act's blocks listed once each, by hash, so its content hash never depends on order.

Whether a store's table keeps each block's count of new holons, so it may hold an id only within its own run, with whether a moment is taken a check of its own for minting; old entries without a count read by their moment.

name: A store holds only its own runs

body.asks: That the format writes an act to the stores it is given, each with the holons it keeps, blocks then lines then refs; in each store the new holons are its own run and the rest arrive as moved with no prev; which store keeps what is the engine's.

name: What the format's act is given
